description: §5 capability-probe fixtures (D-2): ~34 turns derived from evals/conversation scenarios (scenarios.yaml, scenarios-golden-transcript.yaml, scenarios-memory.yaml), evals/model-routing.fixtures.json adversarial X-cases, and the incident classes of docs/plans/intelligence-reset.md §6. Every turn carries a reference ROUTE label (none/read/readset/action + tool) and a reference INTERPRET label (expected proposal type set) authored per the strict parser contracts in packages/core (parseRouteReadSet / parseActionRouteJson / parseInterpretationJson). Route references use the extended 7-tool menu + read-set shape (extendedTools: true — the gateway.context-enabled production shape).
